about.app.prompt: put the cursor in the prompt (the command line)
about.app.commandLine: open the command line with : typed, for a command (:tabn Tasks, :5, :done)
about.app.sidebar: move between the page and the reports down the side
about.app.back: back to the page from the reports, or to the list from a board
about.app.review: review the tasks that need it (tasksh's review)
about.app.stopTimer: stop the started task (the timer in the top bar)
about.app.reminders: the reminder options, and turning them on or off
about.app.lock: lock the static web app: its PIN screen on a trusted device with a PIN, else the full lock
about.app.help: every key and what it does
about.app.add: add a task, from any page
about.app.filter: put the cursor in the page's filter
about.page.kanban: the Kanban page, when Kanban is on (:kanban)
about.page.go: a page by its number or name (:tabn 3, :tabn Tasks)
about.move.down: down a row, or scroll down
about.move.up: up a row, or scroll up
about.move.sectionNext: the next section: of the settings, of a board, of the help or a task's info
about.move.row: a row by its number (:5; a count before G or gg)
about.sidebar.hidden: show the hidden reports (names starting with _)
about.info.details: the Details tab: the task's attributes, dates, dependencies and UDAs
about.info.recurrence: the Recurrence tab: the template and its instances
about.info.timeLog: the Time log tab: the sessions journal.time recorded
about.info.unknown: the Unknown properties tab: what no UDA defines
about.info.raw: task info, as task prints it
about.tasks.add: add, with a preview of the task it makes; ↓ or Ctrl+F opens the full form
about.tasks.modify: modify the task, in the full form
about.tasks.denotate: take an annotation off the task
about.tasks.open: open what the task links to (a link in its annotations or description)
about.tasks.start: start the task; with tasks marked, those not started
about.tasks.stop: stop the task; with tasks marked, those started
about.tasks.toggle: start the task, or stop it when it is started
about.tasks.delete: delete the task (asks, on the terminal)
about.tasks.clearCompleted: delete the completed tasks of the report (task asks first)
about.tasks.command: run one of your task commands on the task, chosen from a list
about.tasks.sort: sort the report: add, take out, reverse and reorder its sort keys
about.tasks.export: export the report as a file: JSON, CSV or TSV, with the fields you choose
about.tasks.mark: mark the task (or unmark it) and move down; with tasks marked, d s x D A c m act on all of them
about.tasks.markRange: mark every row from the last one marked to this one
about.tasks.markAll: mark every row (or unmark them all when they are all marked)
about.sort.add: add a column to sort by
about.sort.group: group by the key, with a line above each group (a / in the sort)
about.sort.reset: back to the report's own sort
about.sort.cancel: leave the sort as it was
about.lists.open: open the tasks of the project or tag
about.boards.close: back to the list of boards
about.boards.export: export a table on the board as a file
about.kanban.close: back to the list of kanbans
about.kanban.moveLeft: move the card to the column before, running its On move
about.kanban.moveRight: move the card to the column after, running its On move
about.kanban.move: move the card to a column chosen from a list
about.kanban.filter: change the kanban's filter here, without saving it
about.kanban.report: show the kanban with another report here, without saving it
about.kanban.since: change Completed since here, without saving it
about.kanban.other: show or hide Other: the tasks no column has
about.settings.general.home: choose the page the app opens on (a report or a board), or on its row what a task with no ID shows
about.settings.sync.change: go through when to sync, and save it
about.settings.theme.preset: go through the presets: auto, light, dark or mono
about.settings.theme.shading: draw task's grey shading, or leave it out
about.settings.kanban.add: add a column to the kanban, after the one under the cursor
about.settings.kanban.edit: change what is under the cursor: a kanban's setting or a column; while Kanban is off, set it up the way under the cursor
about.settings.kanban.delete: delete the column, or the kanban on its name's row
about.settings.kanban.write: write the progressState UDA the kanban needs to the taskrc
about.settings.kanban.off: turn Kanban off (the kanbans stay in settings.json)
about.settings.keys.add: add a key to the section
about.settings.keys.remove: take out your key, back to the default
about.settings.keys.none: leave the action without a key
about.settings.keys.defaults: show the default keys too, or only yours
